notes: Tail case, all units rewritten. U1 mask is the man's blue T-shirt (ref was 'person'); U2 bike replace made structural; U3 retargeted from a tiny 79x20 px LED sign to the man in a red polo walking at the right (new SAM3 mask); U4 is a patio umbrella, not a canopy.

spec.ref: the blue T-shirt of the man in black trousers at the lower left

units.ref_zh: 左下方两个女孩骑的黑色儿童自行车

units.reason: Retarget: old target was a tiny 79x20 px red LED sign (ambiguous among other signs). New target is the only red-shirted walker on the right; SAM3 'person' mask t2_1 verified, committed U3_v2.png.
